QUOTE: `archiveChannel`) | Sets local `delete_at` so the channel stays visible as archived | Removes the current user from the channel locally; and `searchPosts`... websocket row: "Keeps the archived channel in the local DB | If the user is viewing it, kicks them out with `CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`, then removes the membership"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The table states that when archived channels aren't viewable, the user is removed and kicked out if viewing it. When viewable, the channel is kept and marked with `delete_at`, which is "marked deleted".
